issue: Can a federal prisoner whose sentence was enhanced under the mandatory Sentencing Guidelines residual clause obtain relief under 28 U.S.C. § 2255 based on Johnson, and is such a motion timely?

sides.position: A defendant sentenced under the mandatory Guidelines residual clause may bring a successful Section 2255 motion in light of Johnson.
cases: Cross v. United States, 892 F.3d 288 (7th Cir. 2018)

sides.position: Such Section 2255 motions are untimely and cannot succeed.
cases: United States v. London, 937 F.3d 502 (5th Cir. 2019)
Russo v. United States, 902 F.3d 880 (8th Cir. 2018)
United States v. Green, 898 F.3d 315 (3d Cir. 2018)

quote: The circuits have split over this same question.
cite: United States v. Brian Carr, 946 F.3d 598 (D.C. Cir. 2020)
